open_points.subject: store.read_records relation call signatures
open_points.text: "A call names the relation and passes the records its name mentions — a slot, a contract version, an implementation and a corpus digest, a flow, a flow version and a run, a run, an element, a flow version's node — or, for \"by status\", the status."
open_points.question: For each named relation, what exact argument list (fields, required/optional, order) must callers pass?
options: Define an explicit signature per relation (e.g., `verdict of an implementation over a corpus digest` takes exactly `implementation_id` + `corpus_digest`)
Keep free-form relation payload and let each caller/store-side branch interpret
open_points.default_guess: Implement explicit per-relation signatures and reject any extra/missing argument as caller defect/internal_error.

open_points.subject: MCP read_spooled_file input validation
open_points.text: "...names it by its identity ... the lookup identity; its digest, size and media type only describe it..."
open_points.question: If caller supplies digest/size/media_type that do not match the located SpooledFile record (while lookup identity matches), must the operation ignore those fields or refuse?
options: Ignore descriptive fields entirely (lookup keys only)
Validate descriptive fields against record and refuse on mismatch
open_points.default_guess: Ignore descriptive fields for lookup and return bytes if identity keys match and spool is still held.

open_points.subject: get_repair_view continuation token binding
open_points.text: "...with a continuation token that also carries the implementation set of its first page; passed back, it pages only the NodeExecutions below that position for that set..."
open_points.question: Is the continuation token also bound to the same slot_id (and other request selectors), and what refusal applies if reused with a different slot?
options: Bind token to slot_id + captured implementation set; mismatched slot is `invalid_request`
Honor token’s embedded set/position regardless of provided slot_id
open_points.default_guess: Bind token to the original slot context and refuse (`invalid_request`) when reused with a different slot.
